build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run --cwd ../frontend build && bun run --cwd .. scripts/fetch-sidecar.ts --verify-staged

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop shell for the Oh My Pi coding agent.
bundle.longDescription: A desktop client for the Oh My Pi (omp) coding agent. Every open thread is an omp --mode rpc-ui child process the app supervises; the window speaks the engine's own RPC protocol and renders sessions, transcripts, approvals, settings and subagents. The pinned engine binary and the third-party attribution it requires ship inside the bundle.
